name: dsh-social-desk
description: Local, reviewed social publishing queue for DSH Vibeify.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare, review and schedule social posts from Vibe.
interface.longDescription: Turns one cleaned Vibe article into channel-specific drafts, keeps every account and draft local, publishes configured official-API posts after one explicit Approve and schedule action, and holds community channels in a reviewed Ready to post queue.
defaultPrompt: Prepare social posts from this Vibe article.
Explain which channels can publish and which are Ready to post.
